package.name: mecanum_nav
package.description:
SLAM and Nav2 bringup for the 4WD mecanum-wheel robot.
This package exists so the Ackermann (JetAcker) configuration stays untouched: nothing here modifies the slam/, navigation/ or driver/ packages, it only provides mecanum-specific launch files and parameters that reuse the same nodes. Run the Ackermann stack from slam/navigation as before; run the mecanum stack from here.
